title: Wording for ISF
body:
![Screenshot_20240127_065049_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/76626474/416b1baf-73dc-4382-8f3b-910ad5abb3c5)

We used _sensitivity_ for AutoSens till now. Now it is used for ISF. It is not clear what we're talking about. Better use ISF instead of sensitivity
